findings.title: Required terraform validate evidence is missing
findings.detail: The task mandates the module pass `terraform validate` via the throwaway harness and that the review confirm the coder recorded 'Success! The configuration is valid.'. No such evidence is available on this pass: the module files are unchanged since the previous review (mtimes 19:16-19:18, prior review 19:22), there is no git repository (no commit message), and there is no coder report/notes/log under .agents/ (only microservice-plan.md and the prior review outputs). The permitted narrow spot-check `terraform fmt -check -recursive modules/microservice` passes (exit 0), but that is not a substitute for `terraform validate`, and re-running the validate harness is out of scope for review.
findings.consequence: The mandatory verification gate is unsatisfied; there is no confirmation the configuration actually validates, so approval cannot be granted even though the static read matches every plan requirement (a)-(i) and is internally consistent.
findings.correction: Run the validate harness (minimal-vars variant and the fully-enabled variant with create_ingress=true, create_pipeline=true, dummy connection/repo/bucket, and a non-empty policy_statements), record the exact 'Success! The configuration is valid.' output in the coder's final/commit message so the reviewer can read it, and delete the harness afterward.
